title: Unit 336
style: Urgency jazz with clipped swing drums, prowling upright bass, and sharp muted trumpet stabs; verse rides tight bass comping and restless ride cymbal, pre-chorus opens with brushed snare rolls and rising horn clusters, chorus hits with stacked trumpet lines and gang vocal shouts. Filtered radio bursts, tape hiss, and quick horn falls bridge transitions. Bright, punchy, noir-close mix with male vocals and double-tracked hook lines., low, jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Export thread, master
Seamstress, master weaver
Believer, unit three-three-six
In the wire, I read the fever

Car chase, slow lane
Sneaky path on wet stone
Pathera pounce in the backseat
Low flo style, bone to bone

[Pre-Chorus]
Delta, alpha
Plans in the dark sky
Two eyes on the mirror
One third eye open wide

[Chorus]
Unit three-three-six
Move, move, move
Unit three-three-six
We cut right through

Two eyes, one third
One mirror for each
Unit three-three-six
We lean, we reach

[Verse 2]
I keep the export clean
No dust on the ledger
Every line got a pulse
Every pause gets better

Master weaver, tie it
Thread by thread, no slack
If the night takes a left turn
We already know the map

[Pre-Chorus]
Delta, alpha
Plans in the dark sky
Two eyes on the mirror
One third eye open wide

[Chorus]
Unit three-three-six
Move, move, move
Unit three-three-six
We cut right through

Two eyes, one third
One mirror for each
Unit three-three-six
We lean, we reach

[Bridge]
Hold that breath
Hear the horn call
If they close one door
We slip past all

Hands on the wheel
Mind on the seam
Master weaver, believer
We’re inside the dream

[Final Chorus]
Unit three-three-six
Move, move, move
Unit three-three-six
We cut right through

Two eyes, one third
One mirror for each
Unit three-three-six
We lean, we reach
